note.en: On-chip SRAM is 352 KiB (360448 bytes), following AC7926A Datasheet V1.5. The development board overview lists 256 KiB; this manifest uses the datasheet figure.
note.zh-CN: 片上 SRAM 为 352 KiB（360448 字节），按 AC7926A Datasheet V1.5 记载。开发板概述另列为 256 KiB；本 manifest 采用芯片手册数值。

note.en: count and pinout list the 83 regular GPIO-capable pads shown on the AC792N Develop V1.2 top-board connectors: PA1-PA15, PB0-PB15, PC0-PC13, PD0-PD15, PE0-PE15 and PF0-PF5. PA0 is present in the WL83 SDK GPIO mask but is not shown on these board connectors, so it is excluded. The WL83 SDK/TKL logical address space is not a guarantee that each code is exposed on this board. These pads are muxed with board functions and may need those functions disconnected or reconfigured before use as GPIO. USB-special GPIO codes 96/97 and 112/113 are excluded from this regular GPIO count.
note.zh-CN: count 和 pinout 列出 AC792N Develop V1.2 主控板连接器上标出的 83 个常规 GPIO-capable pad：PA1–PA15、PB0–PB15、PC0–PC13、PD0–PD15、PE0–PE15、PF0–PF5。WL83 SDK GPIO 掩码包含 PA0，但该开发板连接器未标出 PA0，因此不计入。WL83 SDK/TKL 逻辑地址空间不代表每个编号都在本板物理引出。上述引脚与板载功能复用，作为 GPIO 前可能需要断开或重配相关功能。USB 专用 GPIO 编号 96/97、112/113 不计入常规 GPIO 数量。

note.en: Interrupt capability is decided per pad by the vendor exti_init(); the adapter forwards the request and returns its result. The board exposes 83 GPIO pads, but which of them carry EXTI is not established, so no list is given.
note.zh-CN: 中断能力由厂商 exti_init() 按焊盘判定，适配层只转发请求并返回其结果。板上共有 83 个 GPIO 焊盘，但哪些具备 EXTI 尚未确认，因此不列出具体引脚。

note.en: Only 8N1 without flow control. UART0 carries the log console on PD1/PE11; UART1 is the SDK uart2 block on PB4/PB5. Receive is interrupt driven.
note.zh-CN: 仅支持 8N1、无流控。UART0 是 PD1/PE11 上的日志串口；UART1 对应 SDK 的 uart2，引脚 PB4/PB5。接收为中断驱动。

note.en: IIC0 and IIC1 are hardware buses (100 kHz / 400 kHz / 1 MHz, 3.4 MHz rejected); IIC2 is the software bus with fixed timing, so its requested speed is ignored.
note.zh-CN: IIC0、IIC1 是硬件总线（100 kHz / 400 kHz / 1 MHz，3.4 MHz 被拒绝）；IIC2 是软件模拟总线，时序固定，请求的速率不生效。

note.en: Master only, 8-bit, mode 0; the rate is set at init. Chip select is driven by the caller as GPIO. Per-pin pinmux works only before the port is opened.
note.zh-CN: 仅主机、8 位、模式 0；速率在初始化时设置。片选由用户当作 GPIO 驱动。逐管脚的 pinmux 只在端口打开前有效。

note.en: Four MCPWM channels, each driving a complementary H/L pair; the pin listed is the H side (L: 25, 10, 27, 29). cycle == 0 is treated as 10000.
note.zh-CN: 四路 MCPWM，每路驱动一对互补的 H/L，表中所列为 H 引脚（L 分别为 25、10、27、29）。cycle 为 0 时按 10000 处理。

note.en: ADC0, 10 bit, 3.3 V reference, at most 8 channels per request. Single sampling is rejected. Scan sampling is accepted by the adapter as well.
note.zh-CN: ADC0，10 位，3.3V 参考，单次请求最多 8 个通道；单次采样被拒绝。适配层也接受扫描采样。

note.en: One logical timer can be active at a time; a second start returns OPRT_RESOURCE_NOT_READY. Callbacks run in the SDK timer task, not in an ISR.
note.zh-CN: 同一时刻只能有一个定时器处于活动状态，第二次启动返回 OPRT_RESOURCE_NOT_READY；回调在 SDK 定时任务中执行，不在中断里。
